title: Search Naver News and Navigate to Top Article
description: Searches Naver for a given keyword, extracts news titles and links, saves them to a JSON file, extracts the top 3 news articles, and navigates to the URL of the first article.

variables.name: search_keyword
variables.description: The keyword to search for on Naver.

variables.name: news_url
variables.description: The URL of the Naver News page after the search.

variables.name: first_article_url
variables.description: The URL of the first news article extracted from the search results.

metadata.originalPrompt: 네이버에서 한로로 검색하고 뉴스탭에서 뉴스 타이틀과 링크 추출해서 저장해주고 파일 path알려주고 뉴스 Top3 추출해주고 Top3중 첫번째 URL에 접속해줘
